The 58-solid 17-station Hertz-Boussinesq elastic contact bench compares closed-form evaluation against 64-ring hemispherical pressure quadrature (0.21 ms vs 10.63 ms at 8,192 passes, 50.36× speedup, <1e-12 error) without claiming neural soft-body simulation.
